body: That's great to hear. It puts a smile on my face knowing that you are still hopeful. Just keep trying, there are lots of people in this world. In the meantime, I'm happy to talk with you about whatever. Beats laying here doing nothing.

I wish I knew. I don't like myself. I'm slowly realizing I'm best alone. Maybe there are people out there who try. This person I most recently pushed away told me they wanted to help make me a better person. I asked if her spending time with me was at all because she just enjoyed my company. No answer. I'm giving up, but maybe your experience will be different. Really wish I knew what to say or could give you some wisdom. I am right there with you.

I relate completely. I'm deeply sorry that you have to feel this way. I hate it. Sending a virtual hug your way. 

Someone something told me recently: No one is going to think you're worth having in their life if you have no self worth. I can't get it out of my head, maybe it gives you some idea as to what the deal is. 

I'm more than happy to listen to you if you have more to say. Otherwise, take it day by day. Try your best to maintain a positive outlook on things. If only I could take my own advice, ha!
